about.title: Who am I?
about.name: I am Jonas Jensen
about.description:
As a graduate multimedia designer from UCL Odense, I combine creative thinking with technical precision in all my work. My passion lies in developing intuitive user interfaces and creating digital experiences that both impress visually and function optimally.

I have specialized in frontend development with React and Vue.js as well as cross-platform app development with Flutter. My experience ranges from design in Figma to implementing Firebase solutions and complex API integrations. I thrive in the intersection between design and code, where I can combine the aesthetic with the functional.

To expand my technical toolkit, I am currently pursuing IBM Backend Professional Certificate and Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, which gives me a comprehensive understanding of the entire digital value chain – from the user's first interaction to the database's secure management of data.

projects.title: Selected Projects

portfolio.title: Portfolio Website
portfolio.description: My personal portfolio, built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. The site is designed with inspiration from the ocean and includes custom animations and a dynamic scroll-progress bar for a unique and interactive user experience.
portfolio.content1: This portfolio is intended to be more than just a gallery; it is a demonstration of my technical and creative abilities. It is built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript to achieve optimal performance, type safety, and a modern development experience. The entire design concept is inspired by a dive into the ocean, where the user moves deeper through the content.
portfolio.content2: To realize the unique user experience, I have implemented several custom features. A dynamic scroll-progress bar shows how far the 'dive' has progressed, and the navigation updates automatically to highlight the current section. I used CSS Modules for scoped styling and created subtle animations to make the interaction lively and engaging.
portfolio.content3: As my first major project in React, this site has been a fantastic learning journey. It has solidified my understanding of React Hooks, component-based architecture, and the benefits of Next.js's server-side rendering. The project demonstrates my ability to combine technical implementation with a creative design concept.

hairplant.title: Hairplant App
hairplant.description: A cross-platform Flutter application revolutionizing hair transplant journeys. The app enables users to track their progress, upload mandatory status photos, receive expert feedback, and communicate directly with the support team.
hairplant.content1:
Hairplant began as a vision to digitalize and enhance the customer experience throughout their hair transplant journey. The idea was to create an all-in-one platform where users could track their progress, upload documentation, and have direct contact with their clinic – all in their pocket.

The project started with extensive research and user interviews to understand the real needs. Wireframes and prototypes were then developed in close collaboration with the clinic and potential users to ensure the solution addressed the right challenges.
hairplant.content2:
Development was built on Flutter to ensure a consistent experience across Android, iOS, and web. Firebase was chosen as the backend solution due to its scalability, real-time database, and built-in authentication.

One of the most challenging aspects was designing an intuitive upload system for status photos, where users needed to take pictures at specific points in their journey. The system had to be both user-friendly and ensure the clinic received the necessary high-quality documentation.
hairplant.content3:
The app also includes an intelligent notification system that reminds users to upload photos on the correct days of their journey. An integrated chat function gives users direct access to support, which has significantly improved customer satisfaction.

The project is now in beta phase with real users, and the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive. The Hairplant app demonstrates my ability to take a project from idea to deployment, handle complex user interaction, and create value through technology.

internship.title: Internship Project
internship.description: Developed a complete Flutter administration app with a Firebase backend for a school application. The project included a live-data dashboard, mentor system, and user management to automate administrative processes.
internship.content1: During my internship at Lighthouse Digital, I was tasked with building a modern admin panel for an existing school app. The core of the project was to provide schools with tools to manage their own data and gain insights through an intuitive dashboard.
internship.content2:
The existing mobile app was built on an older version of Flutter (2.x), making a direct extension impractical. I therefore made the technical decision to rebuild the admin panel from scratch in Flutter 3.26+. This ensured a future-proof and maintainable solution. By reusing the existing Firebase/Firestore backend, I could focus on frontend development and new features.

A key challenge was the implementation of data visualizations. To get the graphs to work correctly, it was necessary to restructure parts of the Firestore database and extend the user data model. This was an educational process in data modeling and problem-solving in a live environment.

Additionally, I developed a complete mentor administration system, where schools can easily approve new mentors, view their status, and manage access.
internship.content3: This project was a fantastic opportunity to dive deep into Flutter/Dart and build an application from the ground up. It gave me a solid, practical understanding of state management, dependency handling, and the interaction between a frontend app and a BaaS platform like Firebase. Within a 3-month internship, where the first month was dedicated to learning Flutter, I am proud to have delivered a functional and value-adding solution.

exam.title: Exam Project
exam.description: As my final exam project, I upgraded a live website from Nuxt 2 to Nuxt 3, including a complete redesign. The project demonstrated technical depth in Vue.js and a strong understanding of UI/UX principles.
exam.content1: My final exam project was a technically challenging migration of a live commercial website from Nuxt 2 to Nuxt 3. The task involved not only upgrading the framework but also a complete UI/UX redesign to modernize the user experience.
exam.content2:
The biggest challenge was the lack of user data or analytics for the existing site. The redesign, therefore, had to be based on UX heuristics, competitor analysis, and web design best practices. The process involved wireframing, prototyping, and user testing to validate design choices before implementation began.

The migration itself from Nuxt 2 to 3 was a complex task that required an in-depth understanding of breaking changes and the new Composition API. It was an educational process in planning and executing a technical migration with minimal downtime.
exam.content3: The project was a success and received high praise for both its technical implementation and improved design. It gave me valuable experience working on complex Vue.js projects and strengthened my skills in frontend architecture, UI/UX, and project management.
